entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I hope you can help. I need to return something and I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for these.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into a return for you. To get started, can I please have your name and order number?
My name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF886-01. It's for the cycling shoes. I've been a loyal customer for years, I really thought these would be the ones.

Thank you, Sam. I see your order for the Velo-Pro cycling shoes right here. I'm sorry they didn't work out. To best help, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?
It's the fit. They just hurt so much. I've tried everything, even adjusting the cleats over and over, but they just give me awful blisters on my heels. I really need to get my money back for this.

Getting blisters is definitely not what we want for our customers, I completely understand. It sounds like it’s a sizing issue rather than a defect with the shoes themselves. Let me just pull up the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay... I just really need that refund. With the holidays coming up, every little bit helps.

I understand completely. Okay, I've checked the policy. It looks like you received the shoes 31 days ago, and for standard items like our cycling shoes, we have a 90-day return policy. You are well within the window, so I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them.

Not at all, I'm happy to help. I have just initiated that return for you. I'm sending an email now with a pre-paid shipping label. Just pack the shoes and the cleats back in the original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be issued.
That's perfect. Thank you, Diana. You've really made my day.
You're very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was it. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
